items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...we mentioned him. ... Let's mention some other great musicians that you know, that you played with, from that era.

ctx.x: P R O C E E D I N G S
This is starting our tape three, and we're talking with Quentin Jackson, super sideman. He's probably played with more name bands, more great bands, than any other living jazz musician.

Butter, we were just rapping here about the qualities or qualifications of such great men as Bennie Carter and Don Redmon and the era and the bands we played in. We checked -- I think we went through Russell Smith and Joe Smith and Rex Stewart and Russell Smith and the brothers, Bobby Starks and Charlie Shavers and Pops Armstrong, we mentioned him.

We're in 1933 now, right? 1933?
